visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Comparing Boxed Numbers with ==
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both numbers are 1000, so the program should print equal, but it prints different.

solution.explanation: == on two Integer objects compares references. Values from -128 to 127 are cached and share one object, but 1000 creates two separate objects, so == is false. equals compares the numbers.
